title: Lockr
description: SaaS platform for fitness coaches — client check-ins, training plans, progress photos, and payment collection in one mobile-first dashboard. Built end-to-end solo: React + TypeScript frontend, Cloudflare Workers + Postgres backend, JWT auth, local payment rails, and a two-environment Playwright test suite guarding every release.

title: Aimina
description: Self-retraining AI editorial agent that triages the day's news across MO4 Network's publications — GPT scoring, vector-embedding similarity search for deduplication (Supabase + pgvector), and Telegram delivery. Turned hours of manual multi-feed review into an automated morning pipeline that retrains itself weekly against evolving publication standards.

title: Scrapling
description: Distributed scraping engine monitoring vendor pricing and stock across every major e-commerce platform daily — Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, and 19 more. Atomic Postgres syncs with fail-safe sweep logic, AI product categorization, and day-over-day change detection. FastAPI, Docker, and n8n orchestration, engineered to survive anti-bot walls and 50k-item catalogs.

title: ReportFlow
description: Automated Instagram campaign reporting for a 14-brand media network — pulls performance data from Airtable, captures live post and story embeds with headless Chromium, and renders branded, client-ready PDF reports. Eliminated manual screenshotting and deck-building from the media buying workflow entirely.

title: Botit Sidekick
description: Executive ops dashboard giving management real-time visibility into vendor health, team status, and key metrics — replacing fragmented updates with a single source of truth.

title: Trader
description: AI-augmented trading signal engine for the Egyptian Exchange and crypto — custom technical analysis across 261 tickers and 18 sectors, Gemini-driven evaluation, and Telegram delivery with one-tap trade logging. Validated by 37 backtest runs and live forward-testing.

title: AudioViz
description: Real-time audio visualizer bridging software and hardware — FFT analysis drives on-screen effects and physical ESP32 LEDs over a custom binary serial protocol, with beat detection, automatic gain control, and GPU-accelerated video export.

title: Nathalie
description: Internal ops platform combining push notifications with an AI assistant — teams query project status and get live updates through a simple chat interface instead of chasing emails.

title: Botit Emails
description: Automated vendor communication pipeline delivering personalized status emails daily based on live system data — eliminating manual follow-ups and keeping every vendor informed without human effort.

title: The Spyfall Game
description: Multiplayer social deduction game with a chaos twist — built for local pass-and-play and real-time online sessions. The kind of game that ends friendships and starts rematches.
